figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM customers WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE sales >= 600) ORDER BY customer_name DESC;

parts.label: 取数
parts.note: 结果表最终显示 2 列：customer_id、customer_name。

parts.label: 筛选
parts.sql: WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE sales >= 600)
parts.note: 只保留满足这个条件的行：customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE sales >= 600)。

parts.label: 排序
parts.note: 按 customer_name DESC 排列结果。

steps.label: WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE sales >= 600)
steps.sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE sales >= 600)

steps.label: SELECT customer_id, customer_name
steps.sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM customers WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE sales >= 600)

steps.label: ORDER BY customer_name DESC;
steps.sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM customers WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE sales >= 600) ORDER BY customer_name DESC;
